meta.title: Lison · After the meeting, nothing slips
meta.description: Lison listens to your meetings on your Mac, pulls out what matters and follows everyone's action items until they are done. Early access, by invitation.

hero.title: After the meeting, nothing slips.
hero.lead: Lison listens to your meetings on your Mac, pulls out what matters and follows everyone's action items until they are done.

illustration.label: Example of a recap in Lison: a made-up meeting, its decisions and its action items.

how.title: Three steps, and nothing to do during the meeting.
how.step1Text: Your microphone and the call audio, whatever video tool you use. Lison finds the meeting in your Google Calendar.
how.step2Text: Decisions and their conditions, what is blocked, a client's needs, and who committed to what, by when. Every quote is checked: it was really said.
how.step3Text: Each action item keeps its owner and due date from one meeting to the next. Later meetings bring news of it, and only you close an action item.

benefits.title: Nothing gets lost between meetings.
benefits.item1Text: Decisions, blockers, next steps: a clear recap a few minutes after the end, without taking a single note.
benefits.item2Title: Everyone's actions, followed to the end
benefits.item2Text: Every spoken commitment becomes an action item, with an owner and a due date. It stays tracked until it is done, even three meetings later.
benefits.item3Text: An action item late or blocked? One click and Lison drafts the follow-up to its owner. You read it and send it.
benefits.item4Title: And dictation, anywhere on your Mac
benefits.item4Text: One shortcut, you speak, and the text appears in the app you are using.

local.title: Your meetings stay with you.
local.item1: The audio never leaves your Mac, and the transcription runs on it.
local.item2: The recap is written by your own Claude Code (or Codex), on your own subscription: the meeting text goes through it and nothing else.
local.item3: No Lison server, no account to create.

access.title: Lison opens by invitation.
access.intro: Downloads are reserved for invited people. Everyone else can join the waitlist.
access.testerText: Sign in to Google with the address that received the invitation: that is the one that opens the download folder.
access.step1: Open the .dmg file and drag Lison into Applications.
access.step2: Open Lison. macOS refuses to open it: close the message with “Done”, never with “Move to Trash”.
access.step3: System Settings › Privacy & Security › “Open Anyway”, then your Mac password, then “Open Anyway” one last time.
access.note1: Drive warns that it can't scan a file this large for viruses: click “Download anyway”.
access.note2: Drive shows “Request access”? You are signed in with another Google account, or your invitation is not active yet.
access.note3: macOS refuses because Lison is not notarized by Apple yet during early access.
access.note4: On first launch, an assistant sets up the rest: the transcription models (608 MB), Claude Code and your calendar.
access.waitlistText: Leave your first name and your Google address: we will write to you as soon as a spot opens up.
access.waitlistNote: The form opens on Tally, in a new tab.

needs.title: Before you install
needs.item1: A Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later)
needs.item3: A Claude subscription (Pro or Max), or ChatGPT with Codex
needs.item6: The app itself is in French for now.

legal.title: Privacy
legal.who: Waitlist information is kept by the Lison team, and by no one else.
legal.what: The first name, address and optional answer left in the form, and what Google Drive records when you open the download folder.
legal.why: Only to invite you to test Lison. Never sold, never used for advertising.
legal.where: The waitlist is kept on Tally (a Belgian company, data hosted in Europe), downloads on Google Drive. This site is hosted by GitHub Pages, which keeps access logs.
legal.howLong: Until the end of early access, and at most one year after you signed up.
legal.rights: To see your data or be removed from the list, write to
legal.rightsAfter: We do it within a month.
legal.cookies: This site sets no cookies and does not measure its audience.
legal.rightsNoContact: To see your data or be removed from the list, just ask by replying to any of our emails: it is done within a month.

thanks.title: Thank you · Lison
thanks.eyebrow: You are in the first wave
thanks.heading: Thank you
thanks.message: Thanks for wanting to be part of the journey. We can't wait to build what comes next with you, and we'll be in touch soon.
thanks.noteText: What comes next, we build together.
thanks.visualLabel: The Lison symbol, a halo and a wave, at the centre of a glowing circle.
thanks.footer: A small step, a big thank you.
